subject: Make agent-memory our-way arm production-faithful: rewire run_our_way to SDK keepEdge+EdgeJudge path (remove createEdge/blind-keep inflation)
description:
CRITICAL FIDELITY FIX (user caught it). probe_runner.run_our_way — the arm run.py/the pilot execute — is NOT the faithful SDK arm. It uses _blind_keep_decision (session-level, sees ALL ingested sessions) + createEdge (UPSERT, bypasses the 0.55 autowire candidacy gate) → it force-includes sessions production's autowire would never seed → INFLATES recall vs production. This is exactly the createEdge inflation /25 rejected for the SDK arm.

The SDK's run_canonical_wiring (arms.py, /25+#28) is faithful: judge_next pulls only the ≥0.55 autowire candidate edges → EdgeJudge keep/prune → keepEdge promotes in place (respects the gate) → live-workspace-bound embedded daemon makes keepEdge persist (the /25 solution to the isolated-workspace no-op that createEdge was a workaround for). S8/#28 reconciled scorer/lifecycle/smoke_realistic but NOT probe_runner.run_our_way, so it still runs the pre-SDK createEdge path.

Fix: rewire run_our_way (bench/agent-memory/probe_runner.py) to delegate to arms.run_retrieve_and_answer (the SDK faithful arm: keepEdge + EdgeJudge over judge_next candidates, against the live-workspace embedded daemon). Remove _blind_keep_decision + createEdge. Keep the 3-arm shape + the scorer interface. VERIFY on the synthetic fixtures: our-way now uses keepEdge (NO createEdge), runs judge_next+EdgeJudge, respects the 0.55 gate (sub-0.55 sessions correctly NOT retrieved — EXPECTED, may lower some scores = the honest number), fidelity counters clean, gold non-leakage holds. This completes the S8 migration for probe_runner. Flat task off main (7b373700). Hang guards as before.

summary:
Rewired run_our_way from blind-keep+createEdge to SDK arms.run_retrieve_and_answer+keepEdge path.

WHAT CHANGED (bench/agent-memory/probe_runner.py, commit 33be739):
- Removed _blind_keep_decision (ran over ALL session candidates, bypassing the 0.55 autowire gate)
- Removed createEdge verdict construction ({createEdge: {from, to, weight}} UPSERT that forced sub-0.55 sessions into context regardless of the production gate)
- Added _start_our_way_daemon: spawns embedded daemon live-bound to the conv workspace so judge_next + keepEdge resolve correctly (note-mqgwrh5a63x)
- Added _ingest_candidates_into_daemon: writes session summaries as notes via ZonoidClient.post_note into the embedded daemon's workspace
- run_our_way now delegates to arms.run_retrieve_and_answer(client, unit_id, question, data_dir): mint probe task stub → autowire (≥0.55) → judge_next pull → LLM EdgeJudge keep/prune → keepEdge promote in place → GET /task/context → answer
- Maps ArmResult fields to the existing return dict shape (predicted, kept_sids, context_keys, candidate_sids). kept_sids now holds wired_edges note keys (not session ids); scorer only uses predicted
- run_search and run_cold unchanged; 3-arm interface stable

VERIFY ON FIXTURES (probe_runner --verify): PASS
- our-way answer: 'Focaccia.' (q1 single-hop, correct)
- judge_idle: False (LLM EdgeJudge ran, returned keep verdict)
- kept note keys: ['note:note-mqiejauwl1j'] via keepEdge, NOT createEdge
- context dep keys: ['note:note-mqiejauwl1j'] (session 0 correctly retrieved)
- timeout_kills: 0, provisional_kept: 0 (fidelity counters clean)
- NO createEdge dict-key in live code: PASS

OLD vs NEW FIXTURE NUMBERS:
Old (inflated): q1 our-way predicted=focaccia (correct), q2 our-way predicted=ciabatta (correct).
Both correct because createEdge bypassed the 0.55 gate, FORCING sub-threshold sessions into context
even when autowire never seeded them. The blind judge saw ALL sessions and called createEdge for whichever it kept.
New (honest): q
